detail.longDescription:
Unlock the full potential of version control with Learn Git and GitHub 2024, your comprehensive guide to mastering Git and GitHub. Whether you’re a beginner or an advanced developer, this app provides everything you need to become proficient in Git workflows and GitHub collaboration.

Key Features:

	• 79 Detailed Lessons: Learn all the essential and advanced concepts of Git and GitHub through 79 meticulously crafted text-based lessons. From basic commands to advanced branching, merging, and collaborative workflows, you’ll gain expertise with ease.
	• Git Cheat Sheet: Quickly reference key Git commands with our handy Git cheat sheet to streamline your workflow and save time.
	• Step-by-Step Explanations: Each topic is explained step-by-step, making it easy for learners to follow along and implement Git commands in real-world scenarios.
	• Beginner to Expert Coverage: Learn Git and GitHub from scratch, covering everything from initializing repositories to managing collaborative projects.
